_doc: Figura de cuerpo entero para la pantalla de Equipo: de pie, de frente, de la cabeza a los pies, sobre blanco para recortarla. Se entrega como un retrato (img/portraits/<id>.webp). Referencia: el retrato del héroe, para que sea el mismo personaje.
subject: a full-body character figure of {name} for the equipment screen of a fantasy RPG{details}
pose: standing upright and still, facing the viewer with a very slight three-quarter turn, feet shoulder-width apart, arms relaxed at the sides, the whole body from the top of the head to the soles of the boots
mandatory: FULL BODY: the whole figure is visible from the top of the head to the soles of the feet, nothing cropped, with a clear empty margin above the head and below the feet.
The figure is tall and fills most of the height of the image.
Pure flat white background (#FFFFFF), perfectly uniform.
No scenery, no ground, no floor line, no cast shadow, no pedestal, no extra objects or characters.
